home.subtitle: Where Every Child Learns, Plays and Grows With Love
home.welcome_text: At CRÈCHE ARCHE DES ANGES de Bugesera, we provide a safe, joyful and nurturing environment where every child can grow academically, socially and emotionally.
home.mission_text: To provide quality early childhood education that inspires creativity, confidence and lifelong learning in a warm, nurturing setting.
home.vision_text: To become a leading nursery school that shapes happy, responsible and successful children ready to take on tomorrow's challenges.

about.story_desc: Founded by a passionate team of educators, CRÈCHE ARCHE DES ANGES de Bugesera began as a small vision to create a home away from home, combining rigorous pedagogical standards with pure love.
about.phil_desc: We believe that every child is unique. Our approach perfectly blends guided Montessori activities with free play to foster independence, creativity, and joy.
about.growth_desc: From our humble beginnings, we have grown into a multi-classroom facility, expanding our play areas and bilingual curriculum while keeping our tight-knit community feel.
about.future_desc: We are continually looking towards the future, planning to introduce more advanced eco-learning initiatives and expanding our early robotics and arts programs.
about.origins_title: The Arche des Anges de Bugesera Story
about.origins_sub: Discover the passion, history, and ambitions that drive us to provide the best early childhood education.

academics.title: Our Academic Programs
academics.sub: Tailored learning stages designed to meet the unique developmental needs of every child from infancy to pre-primary.

nursery1.obj: Encourage language acquisition, self-expression through art, and social interaction.

nursery2.obj: Develop bilingual vocabulary, cognitive problem-solving, and emotional independence.

nursery3.title: Nursery 3
nursery3.obj: Prepare for formal schooling by mastering alphabets, basic counting, and group cooperation.

preprimary.obj: Achieve academic readiness for primary school, critical thinking, and leadership skills.
